capabilities: Search the vault with blended semantic and keyword (BM25) ranking
Visualize results as a relevance map grouped by topic
Show a panel of notes similar to the one being read
Narrow searches with tag, folder, property, and date filters
Extract text from images via OCR so screenshots become searchable
extras: Downloads the ~100 MB embedding model and OCR language packs once per device; works fully offline afterward. Relevance-tuning and developer docs live outside the README in the original Seek documentation. Indexes OCR only on desktop; mobile devices consume the synced cache.
intentEvidence: Seeker is a fork of Obsidian-Seek by Ryan Manor
motivation: The fork was started to add Canvas and image OCR support and to flag clearly when indexing is not using the GPU, since the original does not take outside contributions.
problem: Obsidian's built-in search matches only exact keywords, so buried notes are hard to find when you cannot remember the exact wording.

relations.evidence: Seeker is a fork of Obsidian-Seek by Ryan Manor
IBM Granite embedding models (Apache-2.0) — the embedding model

summary: Hybrid semantic and keyword vault search powered by a local embedding model, with a result map, similar-notes panel, inline filters, and image OCR.
